Field trip permission

The fifth grade field trip to the science museum leaves at 8:30 am on Friday and returns by 2:45 pm. Students bring a packed lunch and a water bottle.

Families who would like to volunteer as chaperones can sign up at the front office before Wednesday. Each chaperone looks after a group of four students.

Please return the permission slip by Thursday. Students without a signed slip will spend the day in the library with a substitute teacher.
